item.title: Snow Drought Hits the West and Puts Water at Risk
item.description: Ski towns across the West are staring at bare slopes and warm winter air. According to Jim Robbins at The New York Times, snow covered ground has dropped to record lows in places known for deep winters, including Utah, Colorado, and Oregon. That is not just bad for tourism. It is a serious water story.... The post Snow Drought Hits the West and Puts Water at Risk appeared first on One Green Planet.
